mission_04: Excellent! You have successfully generated polynomial features from your original data. You learned how PolynomialFeatures creates interaction terms (x1 x2) and power terms (x1^2, x2^2) that enable linear models to capture non-linear relationships. The include_bias=False parameter avoids adding a constant column since most models add their own intercept. Be cautious with high-degree polynomials as they can lead to overfitting and a combinatorial explosion of features. Always use regularization when working with polynomial features.
